appearance.summary: The target is the exact chibi character in reference two: pink high ponytail with oversized black bow, very small rounded button nose with a flat short profile, large dark eye, gray off-shoulder cropped sweater over black camisole, fitted black shorts with white belt, black mid-calf lace-up combat boots. Preserve her head shape and proportions. Replace every yellow, green, hood, raincoat, and rain boot pixel.
appearance.hair: saturated warm pink hair in a high ponytail tied with a black bow, blunt bangs and two face-framing pieces
appearance.face: large dark brown eyes, thick dark brows, winged black eyeliner, warm medium skin and the same small rounded button nose and jawline
appearance.top: gray off-shoulder cropped ribbed sweater over visible black camisole straps
appearance.bottom: fitted high-waisted black shorts with a slim light-gray belt, clearly shorts and never a skirt
appearance.shoes: black mid-calf lace-up combat boots with thick soles
